top_signals.title: Day Traders Are Abandoning Korean Chip Leveraged ETFs in Droves
top_signals.summary: An onerous mock trading course is becoming an effective tool for South Korea to cool investor fervor over risky products that have turned the country’s $4.3 trillion stock market extremely volatile.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
